item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Kepter 1.3.8
item.description:
Mac Natural Language File Retrieval

Kepter is a local file retrieval and visualization management tool for macOS that aggregates the contents of user-selected folders into a drawer at the edge of the screen, allowing you to find the files you need through thumbnail browsing and natural language search without having to remember file names or save locations. The software uses Apple's device-side model, text recognition and speech recognition capabilities to read documents, scanned copies, and audio and video content. It supports sorting by the amount, date, sender, and other information in the document, and can create reminders associated with the original file based on the recognized date. Screenshots, downloads, and exported files automatically enter the view. Duplicate files are merged and displayed without automatic deletion. Relevant materials can be stacked and grouped without moving the original. Users can also preview zip internal filenames, filter by type or source folder, and drag real files directly into a message or document. Kepter does not need to register an account, the content processing is done locally on the Mac, the record index is encrypted, and the thumbnails are saved in the local cache; the iCloud files that have been read can still be searched through the index even if they are moved out of the local area.

item.title: Showglass 1.1.0
item.description:
Finder Multi-Format File Space Preview

Showglass is a Quick Look extension for macOS that lets you preview 83 file types across code, configuration, documentation, data, zip, fonts, and multimedia categories by selecting a file in the Finder and pressing the spacebar. It will quickly view and integrate into the daily file browsing process, making it easy to confirm the contents of the file before opening the corresponding application. It is suitable for developers, data processors, and users who often organize files in multiple formats. Support scope includes Swift, Markdown, TSV, JSON, Notebook, zip, TrueType, glTF, QOI, Matroska, EPUB, GPX, etc., and table preview can also show column types and column data distribution. The companion app provides access to view examples by file family, search by extension, and drag-and-drop files, and provides Finder icons for 15 file types. Basic features cover 30 types like code, configuration, and Markdown, with Pro extending the remaining 53 types and five additional color themes.

item.title: JMacy 1.2.2
item.description:
macOS Native Download Tool

JMacy is a native macOS download manager developed by Greycore Labs for macOS 14 and above. It is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs, and integrates normal file downloads, browser capture, and BT downloads in the same application. Each file supports up to 16 parallel connections and improves transmission efficiency through dynamic re-partitioning, which can be automatically adjusted when encountering server connection limitations. Support for pausing, resuming downloads, and breakpoint resume after a crash or power outage, reducing the hassle of re-downloading large files. The browser extension captures webpage downloads and media resources, and carries the cookies of the download site, making it easy to handle download tasks that require logging in. It supports Safari, Chrome, Firefox and other browsers. Built-in magnetic link and torrent file support, you can set your own upload speed limit, no compulsory seeding requirements. Provides SHA-256 file verification, image server combination download, clipboard monitoring, and dedicated link evocation, and presents download status through menu bar speed display, system notification, and program docking corner marker.

item.title: hypershot 1.3.5
item.description:
Mac Screenshot Callout Tool

hypershot is a screenshot and image editing tool for macOS and is also available for Windows. It supports a variety of capture methods, including area and window screenshots, timed screenshots, scrolling long screenshots, continuous full-screen frame capture, and composite capture that combines multiple open windows and then edits; full-screen content can be re-photographed after shooting, and the screen scale can be adjusted. The built-in editor provides zoom, pan, rotate, align, and style adjustments, as well as callouts, text highlighting, and background effects. The glass magnifier can enlarge the picture and annotations in the screenshot, and adjust the scaling and edge deformation; the color sampler can read the color anywhere on the desktop, and text recognition can convert the picture text into editable text, and can also decode QR codes and barcodes. Quickly share to apps, contacts, or big language models when you're done, or pin screenshots to your screen for reference. The software supports natively previewed .hypercapture documents, light and dark skins, 11 accents, and 75% to 150% interface scaling.

item.title: DuoBar 1.1.0
item.description:
macOS menu bar system monitoring

DuoBar is a menu bar status monitoring tool for macOS 14 and above that integrates battery, network, memory, and other information into a single icon consisting of a circle, a center symbol, and four dots, reducing the need for multiple status icons to occupy menu bar space. Expand the panel to see the time it takes for the battery to fill, low battery mode, maximum capacity, and number of cycles, to see the last minute upload download curve, processor usage, average load, temperature status, and system uptime, and to see the memory classification and the remaining space for each disk volume. The software provides nine colors, three ring weights, and adjustable icon sizes. The Pro function supports assigning eight indicators to different positions, using gradient or segmented rings, saving and switching configurations such as work and travel, and briefly presenting events such as charging, low battery, headphone connection, and network changes. DuoBar only reads data locally through Apple's public interface, does not collect analysis data, does not track, and does not actively initiate network requests; it only collects the currently displayed indicators, skips sampling when the system is idle, and redraws the icon only when the state changes, and does not display the Dock icon or a separate window for daily operation.

item.title: MSIME(水杉输入法) 0.59.1
item.description:
Open source cross-platform multilingual input method

Spruce Input Method is an open-source multilingual Chinese input method that supports macOS. It integrates Chinese input, candidate word translation and neural association in the same candidate window, which is suitable for daily Chinese writing, foreign language expression and multilingual communication. The software supports full spelling, multiple double spelling schemes, and 86 and 98 five strokes, provides six sets of auxiliary codes, and allows you to import your own input scheme, which is convenient for continuing your existing typing habits. Candidates can display the translation results in English, Japanese and other languages, giving priority to local interpretations. After accessing the translation service, you can use the corresponding candidate translation function. The neural association adopts a language model with a volume as low as 4.5 MB. Combined with the above, the entire sentence candidates are sorted to help select a more streamlined expression. The model and code are open. Input conversion and word frequency learning are completed locally, cloud functions are optional, and networking functions and anonymous usage statistics can be turned off in the settings to facilitate on-demand control of data transmission. The software also covers Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, HarmonyOS and the Web, and provides independently released Rust input engines and C interfaces, which are suitable for ordinary users and easy for developers to integrate input capabilities.

item.title: SwiftBar 2.1.1
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Script Plugin

SwiftBar is an open source menu bar customizer for macOS that converts script output into menu bar titles and drop-down menus that allow users to display status information, execute commands, or access commonly used links on demand. The software supports executable scripts written in your own language, is compatible with BitBar and xbar plug-ins, and has a built-in plug-in repository for easy installation of off-the-shelf extensions. Users can set refresh intervals by filename, use Cron expressions to schedule execution times, or use streaming plug-ins to continuously receive events and update content. The menu supports text colors, fonts, images, SF Symbols, prompts, logos, and shortcuts to fit light and dark colors, respectively. It can also access macOS shortcuts, create temporary menu bar items on demand, and refresh, start and stop plug-ins, or send notifications via the URL Scheme. The plugin directory supports traversing subfolders and exclusion rules, combined with independent caching and data paths, error details and debugging functions, making it easy to organize and maintain personal scripts.

item.title: TablePro 0.86.0
item.description:
Open source native macOS database tools

TablePro is a completely free and open source native macOS database client artifact, built for Mac users, using SwiftUI to build extremely fast startup, only about 50MB of memory, supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Redshift, SQL Server, Oracle, a total of nine mainstream databases, directly connected through their native C library or protocol without any Java/JDBC intermediate layer, providing Tree-sitter incremental syntax highlighting, multi-label editing Editor, intelligent schema-aware auto-completion, in-line Excel-style data editing (supports undo/redo, change tracking, multi-column sorting, filtering, paging, foreign key lookup, enum/set dropdown), CSV/JSON/SQL/XLSX import/export, SSH tunneling (with key/password authentication and ~/... ssh/config import), SSL/TLS encryption, macOS keychain secure storage credentials, automatic reconnection, connection color label management, and integration with powerful AI assistants (Claude, …

item.title: Screendrop 0.38.0
item.description:
Mac Native Screen Recording Software

Screendrop is a native screenshot, screen recording, and video sharing tool for macOS that captures entire displays, designated windows, or free zones, and supports global shortcuts, time-lapse shooting, PNG and JPEG formats, save locations, and automatic post-capture process configuration. The software provides a customizable floating preview stack that allows users to directly copy, compress, save, pin, preview, callout, upload, or delete content, as well as extract screen text without saving images via device-side OCR. Built-in non-destructive callout editor covering Shapes, Arrows, Text, Crop, Smart Masking, Pixelate, Blur, Background, Borders, Watermark, and Perspective. When recording, the screen, camera, microphone, system audio, mouse click and key data can be saved separately, and the speech can be followed by speech recognition on the prompt and device side. After recording, edit clips, speed, smooth zoom, cursor, click effects, subtitles, camera layout, social media frames, and cut video based on transcribed text.

item.title: OpenDisk 1.5.3
item.description:
Open Source Disk Cleaner

OpenDisk is an open source disk space analysis tool for macOS that visualizes the hierarchical occupancy of disks, folders, and files with interactive sunrises. The software supports scanning the full disk or specifying a directory, and the results are streamed in real time during the scanning process. The user can hover the mouse over the chart slice to see the exact size, click the slice to explore the corresponding folder in depth, and quickly return or switch locations through breadcrumb navigation and sortable lists similar to Finder. OpenDisk adapts to APFS volume groups, firmlinks, clearable space, system volumes, and external disks to help keep scan results consistent with the used space displayed by macOS; built-in instant search allows you to enter and return results even on disks containing millions of files. Incremental rescan will reuse the last scan data and replay the file system events, greatly reducing the repetition analysis time; The cleanup collector supports dragging in files and folders, centralized viewing of free space and one-time deletion, and users can also learn about reclaimable storage such as cache through clearable space details.

item.title: HotkeyClash 0.9.4
item.description:
Mac Shortcut Conflict Detection

HotkeyClash is an open source macOS menu bar shortcut conflict detection tool that centrally scans the menu shortcuts of running applications, the configuration files of common automation tools, and system shortcuts to help identify which actions are occupied by the same key combination. It supports Karabiner-Elements, skhd, Keyboard Maestro, BetterTouchTool, Hammerspoon, and Alfred, and can read shortcuts related to Spotlight, Mission Control, screenshots, and Globe function keys. The software separates conflicts into identifying conflicts and potential conflicts, and prompts which operations are more likely to respond first based on the processing order of the driver layer, the event blocking layer, the system layer, the global shortcut key layer, and the application menu layer; When peer competition cannot be determined, it will not be forced to judge. The user can also actually press a key to check which app actually received the input. The interface adopts the two-column layout of the conflict list and detail panel. It supports searching and exporting Markdown reports by application, action or key combination, and the fixed panel makes it easy to modify the configuration.

item.title: EasySnaps 1.26.0
item.description:
macOS Screenshot Recording All-in-One Tool

EasySnaps is a screenshot and recording tool for macOS that provides a complete set of capabilities from area screenshots, window snapshots, full-screen screenshots to scrolling long screenshots, GIF recordings, and screen recordings, covering multiple scenarios such as daily presentations, document organizing, interface sharing, and content archiving. It has built-in direct-editable callout tools that support arrows, shapes, free-form drawings, text, numbered callouts, signatures, and blurring and pixelating, making it easy to quickly add or hide sensitive information after a screenshot. The software also comes with a beautification feature that adds backgrounds, window borders, shadows, rounded corners, and subtle textures to screenshots to make them more suitable for display and publishing. Features such as OCR text recognition, color sampling, shortcut key customization, multilingual interface, and menu bar settings further improve operational efficiency and are suitable for users who need high-frequency processing of screenshots and screenshots. EasySnaps is a screenshot and recording tool for macOS that combines area capture, scrolling long screenshots, GIF recording, text recognition, image beautification, and video editing for everyday communication, product presentations, document organization, and content sharing.

item.title: LunarBar 1.10.1
item.description:
macOS minimalist calendar

LunarBar is a completely free and open source macOS status bar minimalist calendar app that supports features such as lunar calendar, public holidays, system calendar, and reminders. Users can install by downloading LunarBar.dmg from the latest release and dragging it into the app or using Homebrew. LunarBar automatically checks for updates to ensure users are using the latest version. Designed to meet the needs of everyday Mac users, such as viewing the lunar calendar and public holidays, the minimalist design is thoughtful and suitable for users who prefer simple apps. Although the project does not have a feedback channel, you can refer to the wiki for frequently asked questions. LunarBar was originally developed to meet the needs of developers themselves, and there are no plans to develop iOS or widget versions. LunarBar is a completely free and open source Mac status bar minimalist calendar that supports functions such as lunar calendar, public holidays, system calendar, and reminders, and is designed to provide users with a simple and practical calendar experience.

item.title: KeyStats 1.56
item.description:
Menu bar to view keyboard and mouse statistics in real time

KeyStats is a lightweight native keyboard and mouse statistics tool for macOS and Windows. The macOS resident menu bar can record the number of keyboard keystrokes, left and right mouse clicks, mouse movement distance and page scrolling distance in real time, helping users understand daily computer operations and input habits. The core data is displayed directly in the menu bar, and the detailed statistics panel can be opened by clicking on the icon, eliminating the need to switch windows frequently. The software automatically resets the count of the day at midnight every day, and the statistics are still retained after the application restarts to facilitate continuous recording. In terms of privacy, KeyStats only stores summary statistics, does not record input text, key sequence or specific cursor and click location, and the data is saved locally by default. Users can turn on end-to-end encrypted multi-device synchronization on demand, synchronizing the total number of supported daily buttons, single and key combination counts, and mouse button clicks between paired devices; mouse movement distance, scrolling distance, and by application statistics are not currently involved in synchronization.

item.title: Festivitas 1.10.0-beta.2
item.description:
macOS Christmas Lighting

Festivitas brings a festive vibe to your Mac, adding Christmas cheer by adding festive lighting to the dock and menu bar🎄🎵. The app automatically decorates the menu bar and dock with festive lights at launch, and allows users to adjust the appearance of the lighting according to their personal preferences, making your Mac more glamorous and festive during the Christmas season. Whether you're decorating a dock or a menu bar, Festivitas makes your Mac shine and adds to the Christmas spirit.✨ Festivitas is a holiday celebration software designed for Mac that automatically adds holiday lights to your dock and menu bar to make your Mac feel festive🎄🎵. Holiday lighting: Automatically add holiday lighting to the dock and menu bar when the software starts. With Festivitas, your Mac will become more vivid and festive. Whether for work or pleasure, you can feel the strong Christmas atmosphere.

item.title: AnySearch Pro 3.5.6
item.description:
File search tool for macOS

AnySearch Pro is a fast file search and disk content analysis tool for macOS that uses smart indexing and full-text search to find files among hundreds of thousands. A global hotkey opens a floating search panel from any app, and you can search by contains, prefix, suffix, exact match or wildcard. It supports combined filters (extension, type, size, modified date, folder scope, disk source) and searches the text of PDF, Markdown, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, highlighting matches in snippets. Results support quick preview, opening, revealing in Finder, and copying names or paths. Real-time file system monitoring keeps the index current, including iCloud Drive and external USB and Thunderbolt disks.

item.title: HamHub 1.7.3
item.description:
Mac Net Drive with IPTV Video Player

HamHub – Your personal audio-visual expert is a multi-device home audio-visual management and playback macOS app that unifies cloud drives, media servers, and local/network resources into a single, clear repository that helps users organize scattered video files into a searchable, renewable, and synchronized private film and television center. It supports Alibaba Drive, Baidu Drive, Google Drive, WebDAV, SMB, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, IPTV, FTP/FTPS and other sources. It can also automatically identify movies, TV series, variety shows and other structures, and intelligently generate covers, details and episodes. The app has a built-in highly compatible player that supports 4K, Dolby Vision, HDR, Dolby Atmos, ISO Blu-ray Disc, multi-track and rich subtitle formats, and provides a picture-in-picture, continuous playback, gesture control, and speed-doubling viewing experience. Collections, viewing progress, and playback records sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV for users who want to efficiently manage their private library.

item.title: Typeface 4.5.4
item.description:
Professional font manager

Typeface is a beautiful font manager that helps you choose the right fonts for your designs. It organizes your font library with flexible tags and improves your workflow with live font previews. The new version adds detailed metadata lists, custom sorting and partial font families, supports many font formats, and can import Adobe fonts and manage font collections. The PRO version unlocks character overviews, OpenType feature inspection and dynamic previews.

item.title: FluidCast 1.7.3
item.description:
macOS Voice Podcast Player

FluidCast is a modern podcast player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch with a clean and beautiful native interface that makes it easy to subscribe, discover, play, and manage your shows. It supports smart search, offline download, background playback, variable speed playback, sleep timing, CarPlay, play history, OPML import, and local audio file playback for a variety of listening scenarios such as commuting, work, and rest. The app provides program transcription text, generates device-side transcription when the program does not provide subtitles, and supports content retrieval in transcription; Siri can directly ask for podcast transcriptions, program metadata, and program annotations to get answers quickly. Advanced features include cross-device cloud sync, play queue editing, bookmarks, folder organizing, Apple Watch browsing and play management, and AI ad detection based on Apple Intelligence to help heavy podcast users reduce distractions, stay on track, and improve the conversation listening experience with clearer voice enhancements.

item.title: Screens 5 5.10
item.description:
Cross-platform remote desktop control

Screens makes it easy to remotely control your Mac, Windows computer, Linux computer, or Raspberry Pi, whether you're at home, in a coffee shop, or anywhere else in the world. It's a versatile remote desktop solution known for being fast, secure, and reliable, giving you a seamless device control experience. By installing Screens Connect, you can access your computer from anywhere in the world, and Screens also fully integrates with Tailscale, making it easy to connect to a Linux computer or Raspberry Pi remotely. The curtain mode of Screens protects your privacy, the secure connection function ensures a secure connection to the computer, and supports SSH keys to increase security. It also offers features such as accessible Mac login, display selection, clipboard sharing, session selection, and is compatible with the Raspberry Pi 5, supporting file transfers and an easy-to-use interface, while also helping friends and family through the free Screens Assist tool.

item.title: AUDIOEDIT 1.2.11
item.description:
Efficiently cut, merge, and crop audio

AudioEdit is a comprehensive audio editing and conversion tool that provides an easy way to cut, merge, and trim audio. The software brings together all the necessary audio editing tools, and there's more to explore. It allows users to easily combine multiple files into one masterpiece, like a puzzle. Audioedit features cut, paste, merge tools, and fade, fade, and crossover fade to make audio transitions smoother. Users can add as many audio tracks as they want, and the software supports a variety of audio input and output formats. It also uses artificial intelligence technology to reduce noise and improve audio quality. In short, AUDIOEDIT provides a simple, efficient and feature-rich solution for audio editing. Audioedit gives you an easy way to merge, split, and edit your audio. The software brings together all the basic tools in the audio editor and more. Allows you to piece together a complete masterpiece from a multitude of documents. Smooth transition effect: Smooths the audio transition by fading in, fading out, crossing in, and fading out.

item.title: OK JSON 3.1.2
item.description:
macOS Native JSON Editing Tools

OK JSON is a native, programmable JSON formatting tool on the macOS platform, known for its speed and deep integration with macOS. Notable features of OK JSON include: JSON structure display with tree view and text editor support; drag-and-drop functionality, dark mode, URL scheme, quick preview, and excellent performance; built-in support for jq and JSONPath; saving browsing history to a local database; Handle JSON strings with custom scripts supported by JavaScriptCore; quickly preview extensions and official Raycast extensions, and build your own using Apple Script; supports opening JSON Lines, NDJSON, and plist files. Although the core of OK JSON is the JSON formatting tool, its scripting capabilities also make it a text processing tool. OK JSON is a native and programmable JSON formatting tool developed for macOS, known for its fast processing speed and deep integration with macOS.

item.title: Hyperspace 1.8.3
item.description:
Mac Disk Duplicate File Cleaner

Hyperspace is a disk space reclamation tool designed for Mac that is able to search for files of the same content in one or more folders and reclaim the disk space occupied by all of the same files by replacing them with a space-saving clone without deleting any files. This tool leverages the standard features of the macOS file system to process files in a fast way, freeing up disk space with simple scanning, reviewing, and reclaiming steps. Hyperspace allows users to choose to scan multiple folders in order to find more duplicate files and adjust the scanning and recycling behavior through settings. By finally retaining the metadata of the file, the software ensures that the name, permissions, and creation date of the file remain unchanged after the operation, and that the user can still use the file seamlessly while saving disk space. Hyperspace provides a user-friendly interface and detailed documentation to ensure that users can easily stay on top of it. Hyperspace is a tool designed to help users reclaim disk space by searching for files with the same contents in one or more folders and keeping only one copy when found, thereby reclaiming the disk space occupied by the remaining identical files without damaging any files.

item.title: BoxPlayer 2.0.0
item.description:
Full-format video streaming

BoxPlayer is a multi-functional video player for macOS users. It supports common and highly compatible video formats such as MP4, MKV, M4V, MOV, etc., and can play local files, cloud videos, and media server content without conversion. The software supports HDR, Dolby Vision and spatial audio, and provides smooth playback, precise progress control, subtitle management, dual subtitles, audio track selection, picture-in-picture and playback speed adjustment. It can connect to Emby, Jellyfin, Plex and other media servers, is compatible with SMB, WebDAV, AList, and integrates Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, Baidu Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, 115, 123 and other cloud storage services. Built-in TMDB metadata service, which can automatically get movie posters, actor information, profiles and classification content to help organize local and cloud media libraries; It also supports Trakt sync viewing history, NFO metadata, playback cache, IPTV, barrage, and Blu-ray ISO video.

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.13.3
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: Floodtide 1.5.3
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: Keylume 2.4.0
item.description:
macOS Demo Keyboard Tool

Keylume is a stylish on-screen keyboard tool designed for macOS for screen recording and live demo scenes. Keylume provides a complete view of the Apple keyboard, including media keys, arrow keys, and all modifier keys, perfectly matching the look and layout of a real Apple keyboard, many other key visualization tools only show modifier key combinations or omit function keys, while Keylume shows the entire keyboard. Keylume has a variety of beautiful themes built in and an intuitive theme editor that makes it easy for users to create personalized styles, save themes, share them with others, or import themes made by others. Keylume automatically pops up at the start of screen recording and automatically hides after the recording stops, detecting the response in just one second, and also supports manually switching the display by tapping the fn key three times. Keylume supports hovering and tapping fn to enable auto-hiding mode, let the keyboard fade out and allow click penetration, and can freely drag and drag reposition and resize, position information will be automatically remembered. Users can set up app ignore lists to avoid repeated triggering of keyboard displays by background silent recording apps such as backup tools or picture-in-picture utilities.

item.title: superwhisper 3.2.2
item.description:
AI-powered speech input tool

Superwhisper lets you write 3x faster with no hands-on input. It's an AI-powered speech-to-text tool that can be used to quickly take notes, emails, messages, and documents. Superwhisper works wherever and whenever you need it, no matter if you don't have a network. It can easily convert voice notes into any format, whether it's thinking loudly while walking or composing long emails quickly from a single sentence, Superwhisper can help you do it in a professional tone. With Superwhisper, you can use speech writing speed up to 5 times, with perfect punctuation and artificial intelligence formatting for faster and better hands-free writing. It supports more than 100 languages and can translate them into English. In addition, you can use custom vocabulary, including phrases, names, links, or acronyms. Superwhisper's focus on privacy and security ensures that all data is stored only on your device. The primary offline feature means everything is done on your device, no wifi required.

item.title: LaunchMe 3.00.3
item.description:
Launchpad replacement for macOS

LaunchMe is a full-screen workspace launcher for macOS 26 Tahoe and macOS 27 that replaces the removed Launchpad and adds file search, clipboard history, a calculator, music and weather widgets, live wallpapers and automation workflows. It organizes apps, folders, project files and widgets in one immersive interface, and you can save Spaces presets to launch all the apps and files for a task in one click. You can customize folder colors, emoji, covers, app icons, icon size and system icon appearance, hide titles or apps, and summon it with trackpad gestures, hot corners, multi-display support and custom shortcuts. Settings and paths are managed locally, and it pauses its process when hidden to save resources.

item.title: Mote 1.6.0.1
item.description:
macOS Hover Markdown Editor

Mote is a native floating Markdown workbench for macOS that opens a lightweight window above all apps with shortcuts to quickly take ideas, edit notes, run terminal commands, organize web materials, and work on meeting content. It supports WYSIWYG Markdown rendering, with titles, bold, code, checkboxes, and math expressions rendered directly as you type, and offers Vim mode, plain Markdown pasting, and a variety of themes. Mote also integrates YouTube learning notes, microphone and system audio local transcription, speaker tags, Obsidian library reading and writing, web scribbling, clipboard collection, regular review, and AI agent collaboration such as Claude Code. Both notes and transcriptions can be saved locally on the Mac, and the file remains in a user-controlled Markdown format, independent of the cloud, account, or conference robot. Built with Swift and AppKit for macOS 15 and above, the software starts up quickly, takes up less resources, and is suitable for users who need to quickly switch between reading, conferencing, writing, and development.

item.title: DockFlow 1.94
item.description:
Mac Dock Grouping Layout Tool

DockFlow is a workspace switching tool designed specifically for Mac users. It aims to help users quickly create and switch between different dock icon combinations to suit various work scenarios. Users simply set the desired application and folder icons and can easily switch to a custom dock layout via keyboard shortcuts or menu bar icons, improving work efficiency. DockFlow supports adding a variety of items, including folders, files, and URL links, to facilitate one-click access to commonly used resources. DockFlow allows users to set icon intervals, reasonably layout icons, and supports exporting and importing personalized configurations for easy system migration or sharing. With DockFlow, users can quickly adapt to different workflows, eliminating the distractions of context switching and allowing them to focus more on their work. DockFlow is a program dock switching tool designed for macOS users to simplify workspace management and help users quickly create and switch between different combinations of Dock icons to suit different work scenarios. With a one-time setup, DockFlow offers lifelong productivity gains.
